name: Drone: rotor, motor and battery, sizing, 6-DOF control, endurance flown
description: A quadrotor for a payload and endurance: BEMT rotor checked against momentum theory and the APC 10 x 4.7 published data, motor and LiPo models, propeller / pack / motor / arm sizing at a thrust-to-weight margin, LQR control of the 6-DOF dynamics (margins, step, gust), the mission flown until the battery is empty, and the Phantom 4's published endurance (pinneapple_simulation.multirotor.workflow).

params.title: Drone: rotor, motor and battery, sizing, 6-DOF control, endurance flown
